wish: someone should make a horror game where finger snapping lights up the dark
spec: A dark 7x7 room with a creature hunting you; a snap (heard by the microphone) or the flash button lights the room for under a second.\nSteer with the arrow pad to the green exit; every flash also lets the creature step closer.\nIt does not run anywhere but offline on this page; the microphone is optional.
notes: Snap detection is a loudness spike over background; flash button is the fallback.
